title: Answer: the self is the affective subject, with bodily and declarative selves above it

statements.text: Elemental selfhood comes with the Markov blanket, and in vertebrates the experiencing subject is constituted by brainstem affect. Above it are a bodily self in posterior cortex and a declarative self in prefrontal cortex that re-represents the self as an object. The affective self is the source of all consciousness, and the declarative self is unconscious in itself.

sources.quote: the experiencing subject is constituted by affect
The intermediate (posterior cortical) somatosensory-motor self might then be called the "bodily" self.
